Field notes: exact map coordinates for chests/gathering nodes are out of scope.
Two paldb.cc pages 404ed (dynamic character-name petal/plume placeholder items).

Items with no recipe and no obtained_from in priority categories (likely map pickups, shop-only, or 1.0 content paldb has not fully annotated): Ancient Bark, Ancient Bone, Ancient Lava, Animal Skin, BLT, Ballistic Shield, Beer, Bellanoir Libero (Ultra) Slab Fragment, Blazamut Ryu (Ultra) Slab Fragment, Bolognese Sauce, Champion's Emblem, Cheeseburger, Claw, Corn, Corn Soup, Curry, Dung, Fang, Five Shot Bow, Flint, Grape, Grilled Fish, Grilled Meat, Hamburger, Hartalis (Ultra) Slab Fragment, Hop, Hot Dog, Huge Dung, Lightz Helmet, Luminite Bar, Machine Gun Ammo, Magnum Ammo, Mushroom Stew, Paldium Chunk, Potage, Pumpkin, Radar Sphere, Raw Meat, Sand, Sandwich, Scales, Scrapped Tissue Sample, Seafood Soup, Silicon, Stew, Stir-Fried Veggies, Wine, Xenolord (Ultra) Slab Fragment
Per-crop plantation yield_per_harvest and absolute growth-cycle seconds are undocumented in fetched sources (yield scales with gatherer DropNumRate; see plantation_cycles).
Absolute baseline hunger (satiety/sec) and SAN drain/sec are undocumented; only relative multipliers known.
Ancient Hatchery ~10s cycle and near-instant incubation are guide-reported (preliminary), not confirmed on paldb.
Palbox exact base-pal capacity and Feed Box slot count are not listed on their paldb pages.
Incubator hatch-speed multipliers (Electric ~1.5x is EA-era) and per-egg-size base hatch times unknown.
Farmer's Special Dish has no Nutrition/SAN listed on paldb.
Whether Applied <Task> Handbook tiers II+ exist is unconfirmed (only tier I pages found).
Feed Box eating order / cake-in-feed-box behavior not yet re-verified for 1.0 (EA-era sources).

structures.name: Campfire
structures.description: Needed for cooking food. It can only be used to grill simple ingredients. Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

structures.name: Palbox
structures.description: Facility for storing captured Pals. Pals inside gradually recover Health. Area around this facility becomes a base.

structures.name: Straw Pal Bed
structures.description: A straw bed for Pals. Pals can rest on it when injured, or to sleep at night. It isn't soft, but it's better than nothing.

structures.name: Feed Box
structures.description: A box for storing Pal food. Pals can feed from it when hungry. Make sure to keep it well-stocked to keep your Pals happy.

structures.name: Berry Plantation
structures.description: A farm that can grow Red Berries . Harvest time is quick, but eating them doesn't provide much sustenance. Requires a few Pals to plant seeds, water, and harvest the crops.

structures.name: Ranch
structures.description: Farm for raising sheep and fowl-like Pals. Assign a Pal with the appropriate Partner Skill to a farm to produce items.

structures.name: Monitoring Stand
structures.description: Command your Pals to work on various things inside a base. You can allow or prohibit individual kinds of work.

structures.name: Hot Spring
structures.description: Facility where Pals on base can rest. Restores SAN after a long day of hard work.

structures.name: Statue of Power
structures.description: Stone statue spoken of in legends on Palpagos Island. Offer up Lifmunk Effigy to receive strange powers.

structures.name: Egg Incubator
structures.description: Used for incubating a Pal Egg. If a Pal Egg is left in it, it will automatically hatch after some time has passed.

structures.name: Medieval Medicine Workbench
structures.description: A facility for making Pal medicine. It can only produce simple medicines. Leave its operation to a Pal that can make medicine.

structures.name: Cooler Box
structures.description: Small food vault. Assign an Ice Pal to help prevent food stored inside from spoiling.

structures.name: Pal Essence Condenser
structures.description: A chamber for increasing a Pal's rank. Pals can surpass their physical limitations if given a concentrated extract taken from a Pal of the same type.

structures.name: Mill
structures.description: Facility for milling Wheat to produce Flour . Requires Pal with the Watering trait to spin the water turbine.

structures.name: Wheat Plantation
structures.description: A farm that can grow Wheat . It requires an average amount of time to harvest. Requires a few Pals to plant seeds, water, and harvest crops.

structures.name: Cooking Pot
structures.description: Needed for cooking food. Use of a cooking pot allows for a wider variety of meal preparation. Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

structures.name: Heater
structures.description: A device that blows warm air, raising the temperature of a base. It doesn't provide much warmth, but helps one to endure somewhat cold environments. Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

structures.name: Cooler
structures.description: A device that blows cool air, lowering the temperature of a base. It doesn't provide much relief from the heat, but helps one to endure somewhat hot environments. Requires an Ice Pal for cooling.

structures.name: Breeding Farm
structures.description: Assign one male and one female Pal to produce eggs. Placing Cake in the facility is required for production.

structures.name: Pal Labor Research Lab
structures.description: A facility for conducting research on the various tasks of Pals. By assigning tasks to Pals in this facility, research progresses, granting various benefits.

structures.name: Tomato Plantation
structures.description: A farm that can grow Tomato . They take time to harvest, but increase the variety of meals you can prepare. Requires a few Pals to plant seeds, water, and harvest the crops.

structures.name: Pal Expedition Station
structures.description: A facility that allows Pals to be sent on expeditions to places like dungeons. The dispatched Pals engage in battles and gather items, bringing back resources to the base.

structures.name: Clinic
structures.description: A basic medical facility for managing the health of Pals working at the base. Assigning a Pal with Medicine Production suitability helps reduce SAN depletion and prevent illness and injury. While sanitation has its limits, it plays a crucial role in early base development.

structures.name: Fluffy Pal Bed
structures.description: A fluffy bed that Pals can get a good rest on. Pals can rest on it when injured, or to sleep at night. Pals love sleeping on fluffy beds like this.

structures.name: Medicine Rack
structures.description: A shelf for storing medicine. Sick Pals will come here to take their medicine. Be sure to keep the medicine stocked.

structures.name: Lettuce Plantation
structures.description: A farm that can grow Lettuce . It takes time to harvest, but increases the variety of meals you can prepare. Requires a few Pals to plant seeds, water, and harvest the crops.

structures.name: Human-Powered Generator
structures.description: A facility that converts rotational motion into electrical energy. The efficiency is low, and the Pals working here will experience a decrease in SAN value, but they will gain experience points.

structures.name: Power Generator
structures.description: A power generator fueled by Electric Pals. Electric equipment won't run without this.

structures.name: High Quality Monitoring Stand
structures.description: A refined monitoring station with improved materials and structure. In addition to being able to issue work orders, the system also lowers the SAN cost for Pals working at the base. Working conditions are slightly improved, making Pals less likely to become dissatisfied.

structures.name: Potato Plantation
structures.description: A farm where you can grow Potato . It takes time to harvest, but increases the variety of meals you can prepare. Requires a few Pals to plant seeds, water, and harvest the crops.

structures.name: High Quality Hot Spring
structures.description: Facility where Pals on base can rest. Now comfier and restores more SAN.

structures.name: Carrot Plantation
structures.description: A farm where you can grow Carrot . It takes time to harvest, but increases the variety of meals you can prepare. Requires a few Pals to plant seeds, water, and harvest the crops.

structures.name: Electric Egg Incubator
structures.description: Device for incubating Pal eggs. Requires electricity, but automatically keeps the inside of the incubator at appropriate temperatures.

structures.name: Large Pal Bed
structures.description: A fluffy bed that Pals can get a good rest on. Pals can rest on it when injured, or to sleep at night. Even large Pals can sleep soundly on a bed like this.

structures.name: Onion Plantation
structures.description: A farm where you can grow Onion . It takes time to harvest, but increases the variety of meals you can prepare. Requires a few Pals to plant seeds, water, and harvest the crops.

structures.name: Accumulator
structures.description: A facility for storing excess electricity generated by the Power Generator .

structures.name: Refrigerator
structures.description: Large food vault. Assign an Ice Pal to help prevent food stored inside from spoiling.

structures.name: Electric Heater
structures.description: A device that blows warm air, raising the temperature of a base. Using electricity, it can really heat things up. Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

structures.name: Electric Kitchen
structures.description: Needed for cooking food. It requires electricity to run, but allows a large amount of meals to be prepared rapidly. Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

structures.name: Electric Cooler
structures.description: A device that blows cool air, lowering the temperature of a base. Using electricity, it can really lower the temperature. Requires an Ice Pal for cooling.

structures.name: Electric Medicine Workbench
structures.description: A facility for making Pal medicine. It requires electricity, but can produce high quality medicine. Leave its operation to a Pal that can make medicine.

structures.name: Electric Pylon
structures.description: Place in base to improve electricity generating speed. Placing more than one has no additional effect.

structures.name: Large Incubator
structures.description: Device for incubating Pal eggs. It automatically maintains a suitable temperature and can hatch multiple eggs at once.

structures.name: Large-Scale Stone Oven
structures.description: Needed for cooking food. By becoming larger, multiple Pals can cooperate to cook together. Requires a Fire Pal to light a flame.

structures.name: Large Power Generator
structures.description: A power generator fueled by Electric Pals. Larger and with improved power generation efficiency.

structures.name: Cold Food Box
structures.description: A feeding box that can be kept cold. Assign an Ice Pal to it and the food inside will be less likely to spoil.

structures.name: Pal Pod
structures.description: A healing pod for Pals. Used when Pals are injured or to rest at night. Thanks to technological advancements, the healing amount has increased.

structures.name: Large-Scale Electric Egg Incubator
structures.description: Device for incubating Pal eggs. While power supply is required, it allows multiple eggs to be incubated simultaneously at the optimal temperature.

structures.name: Advanced Medicine Workbench
structures.description: A facility for making medicine to cure Pals' illnesses. With advanced technology, it can also create unknown medicines. Assign the task to a Pal capable of pharmacy work.

structures.name: Ancient Kitchen
structures.description: A special kitchen based on ancient technology that can create everything from existing dishes to entirely new recipes. It retains heat through fire and completes cooking with manual preparation, allowing it to prepare any kind of cuisine. It requires Pals with high-level Kindling and Handiwork suitability.

structures.name: Ancient Monitoring Stand
structures.description: A monitoring station based on ancient technology, embedded with Red Paldium. It issues commands across the entire base through a holographic interface, reducing SAN depletion in Pals. A special wavelength surrounds the base, keeping Pals calm even in harsh working environments.

structures.name: Skillfruit Orchard
structures.description: A farm where Skillfruits can be cultivated. By planting the original fruit in the ground, multiple fruits of the same type can be harvested.

structures.name: Ancient Clinic
structures.description: A top-tier medical facility that reproduces advanced ancient medical technology. It offers significantly greater protective capability than a standard clinic. By assigning a Pal with Medicine Production suitability, even bases with harsh working conditions can maintain the highest level of hygiene.

structures.name: Ancient Pal Bed
structures.description: A ulitmate Pal Bed made from ancient recovery pod with soft matress. It offers one of the highest SAN recovery rates of all Pal beds, quickly relieving fatigue. It is the same size as a Large Pal Bed, allowing large Pals to rest comfortably.

structures.name: Ancient Power Generator
structures.description: A highly efficient power generator restored from lost ancient technology. It produces massive amounts of electricity, but is prone to overheating while in operation. It requires Pals with high-level Generating Electricity and any level of Watering suitability.

structures.name: Ancient Hatchery
structures.description: An advanced breeding facility of ancient civilization technology, enclosed in electronic glass. It fully automates everything from egg production to incubation at high speed, and increases the inheritance rate of rare skills. Pals are managed through holograms, it requires minimal pasture space.

structures.name: Ancient Hot Spring
structures.description: A hot spring built with ancient technology, filled with special water infused with Paldium. It offers the highest SAN recovery of all hot springs and also restores Health. It is the same size as a standard hot spring, and can fully heal injured Pals.

structures.name: Ancient Farm
structures.description: A special cultivation device based on ancient technology that harnesses the power of the World Tree to grow all kinds of plants on Palpagos Island. Smaller than a berry plantation and suitable for indoor placement, it still follows the same cultivation process as standard plots. It requires Pals with high-level Planting, Watering, and Harvesting suitability.
